test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for the concept in fixtures/conceptual-depth-bounded.md
test_cases.expected_output: Produces a bounded lookup entry with a clean H1, one concise definition, essential characteristics, and optional disambiguation only where useful; resolves provenance to original Resources in frontmatter, uses the exact prefixed basename/link target when configured, and does not add mandatory provenance, mechanism, application, implications, or Open Questions sections.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a named tool, event, and creative work
test_cases.expected_output: Adapts the bounded body to each subject kind without requiring fixed subtype headings or subtype configuration.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note "Zettelkasten Method" — no Reference note exists yet; two literature notes' Key Concepts already wikilink to it, each with its own grounded characterization from a prior /grounding session
test_cases.expected_output: Gathers the grounded characterization from each literature note (no re-interview — that already happened at the claim level via make-literature-note), reconciles them into one merged definition where they agree or add distinct facets, presents it for confirmation, then writes a fresh Reference note through /write-checks, resolving the field_map for the reference type and the reference-type title prefix.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note "Zettelkasten Method" again, from a third literature note whose Key Concepts also wikilinks to it and is already grounded
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the existing Reference note in full as the working synthesis, folds the third note's grounded characterization in via /write-checks' checks-only mode (sources' mapping already resolved from the first write), appending to the sources frontmatter array rather than overwriting the file wholesale, and inserts a links row with rel_type='extends' pointing at the reference note's own slug.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note "Compass of Zettelkasten Thinking" where two of the three literature notes' grounded characterizations conflict on what the framework claims
test_cases.expected_output: Surfaces the conflict to the user instead of silently picking one side; if the user opts to flag it rather than resolve it now, inserts it into the evergreen backlog via slipbox evergreen add before continuing to write the reconciled definition.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note "Compass of Zettelkasten Thinking" where one of the three candidate literature notes has not gone through make-literature-note yet — no grounded Key Concepts wikilink exists there
test_cases.expected_output: Stops synthesizing from that one ungrounded source and tells the user it needs to go through make-literature-note first, but continues synthesizing and writing from the other two already-grounded sources rather than blocking the whole write.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note with no candidate named
test_cases.expected_output: Asks the user which reference they want written rather than guessing or pulling from any backlog — there is no backlog this skill pulls from itself; the user names it directly, whether on their own or because find-connections --references surfaced it as a recurrence candidate.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note "Deep module" for a new Reference note in a vault whose prefixes.reference is "※ " and whose mapped alternate-name field is aliases
test_cases.expected_output: Adds the exact ordered aliases list ["Deep module"] to aliases while preserving the display casing, alongside the generated prefixed title.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note "Deep module" for a new Reference note in a vault whose prefixes.reference is false
test_cases.expected_output: Does not infer the clean alias value "Deep module" because the unprefixed title is already the note title; writes only explicitly supplied alternate names, and the aliases list does not contain "Deep module".

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note "Deep module" with explicit alternate names ["DM", "deep module", "Deep Module"] and a configured Reference prefix
test_cases.expected_output: Merges the inferred clean name before explicit names, preserving the first spelling and removing case-insensitive duplicates deterministically. The exact aliases list is ["Deep module", "DM"].

test_cases.prompt: make-literature-note or make-evergreen-note with a configured prefix
test_cases.expected_output: Leaves the clean-alias inference untouched because it is Reference-only; the other note types have no equivalent alt_names contract.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note "Zettelkasten Method" again, extending an existing Reference note whose aliases field already contains ["Zettelkasten"]
test_cases.expected_output: Preserves the existing aliases field unchanged as aliases: ["Zettelkasten"], appends the new resource to the sources array without overwriting prior sources, and records a links row with rel_type='extends' to the existing Reference note.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for an authoritative one-source standard with a stable lookup label
test_cases.expected_output: Admits the bounded Reference because entity exclusion, stable lookup identity, source independence, boundedness, adaptive evidence sufficiency, and natural-unit scope pass in that order; one authoritative source is sufficient for this settled standard.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a source-specific coined term with no independent support
test_cases.expected_output: Leaves the candidate unresolved rather than admitting it as a Reference note; source independence is not established.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a contested definition supported by only one source
test_cases.expected_output: Leaves the candidate unresolved until independent support is available; adaptive evidence sufficiency scales with contestability.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a person, location, or organization
test_cases.expected_output: Excludes the entity from Reference admission and keeps it as a surfacing-only Mentioned referent.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a named framework whose functionally dependent substeps appear in the source
test_cases.expected_output: Admits one Reference note for the framework and keeps its substeps inside that natural unit, without separate promoted notes.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a candidate that has not passed the lookup admission sequence
test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke a title-shape heuristic; it reports the failed admission check and stops unresolved.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a settled standard documented by one authoritative primary source
test_cases.expected_output: Returns admitted with the grounded source named as authoritative primary evidence; one source is sufficient for this settled standard and no second source is invented.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a stable bounded concept supported by two independent grounded Literature notes
test_cases.expected_output: Returns admitted and names both independent grounded inputs as sufficient evidence, then proceeds to confirmation before writing.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a bounded concept cited by two syndicated copies of the same source
test_cases.expected_output: Returns unresolved because the duplicated sources are not independent; reports that another independent support path is needed and writes no provisional Reference artifact.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a concept whose grounded sources present materially contested definitions
test_cases.expected_output: Returns unresolved, surfaces the competing variants instead of silently selecting one, and identifies independent support or an explicit user resolution as the next requirement.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note "Private Team Heuristic" directly, with only one source-specific characterization and no independent support
test_cases.expected_output: Returns unresolved despite the direct user invocation, names source independence as the failed gate, reports the independent support needed, leaves the wikilink untouched, and creates no provisional artifact.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a newly admitted reference
test_cases.expected_output: Starts Reference work with activity=create, stages manifest.json, synthesis-map.json, and draft.md under .slipbox/work, checkpoints the reconciled synthesis, obtains genuine user confirmation, and publishes transactionally through /using-slipbox.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note extending an existing note when a new grounded source adds warrant only
test_cases.expected_output: Uses activity=extend-provenance, keeps the existing body bytes stable, appends only deduplicated Resource provenance, stages the artifact and links.jsonl mutations together with expected fingerprints, and performs one work finalize for the Resource→Reference edge.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note extending an existing note when a new source changes the definition boundary
test_cases.expected_output: Uses activity=recompose, stages draft.md and mutations.json with two distinct mutations—one Reference artifact and one links.jsonl ledger mutation—each carrying an expected_fingerprint, then finalizes them together with one work finalize while replacing only the required bounded body fields and preserving unchanged aliases and provenance.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note where grounded sources have conflicting definitions
test_cases.expected_output: Preserves competing definitions in synthesis-map.json, surfaces the conflict, and waits for the user's resolution or explicit decision to flag it; it never silently selects a variant.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note interrupted after synthesis checkpoint
test_cases.expected_output: Resumes the same work_id after inspecting manifest.json, synthesis-map.json, and draft.md, recomputes fingerprints for every mutation path including links.jsonl, and continues from the last checkpoint without publishing incomplete content.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note after the user has confirmed the synthesized definition
test_cases.expected_output: Publishes the already confirmed bounded draft through the transactional work lifecycle; it does not ask for a ceremonial second confirmation or a binary approval ritual.

assertions.text: does not ask for a ceremonial second confirmation

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note when the existing Reference target changes concurrently during recomposition
test_cases.expected_output: Compare-and-swap detects the changed target, blocks finalization, preserves the resumable work, and does not overwrite the concurrent target change.

test_cases.prompt: Migrate a legacy Reference note whose sources contains both [[Literature/foo]] and [[Resource/foo]], whose H1 is prefixed, and whose links ledger has a Literature→Reference edge.
test_cases.expected_output: Audits first, then mechanically cleans the H1, deduplicates provenance to the original Resource, appends a tombstone for the obsolete Literature→Reference edge, and records the corrected Resource→Reference edge transactionally. It preserves the configured prefixed basename/link target and does not rewrite body meaning.

test_cases.prompt: Migrate a legacy Reference note whose Literature source resolves to no Resource.
test_cases.expected_output: Skips that provenance value, reports the unresolved Resource, leaves the note and ledger unchanged for repair, and does not substitute the Literature path or invent a Resource.

test_cases.prompt: Migrate a legacy Reference note with a detailed generative essay and a source-by-source dossier, selecting only this note.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts scoped migration work, re-verifies original Literature and Resource inputs, and classifies every removed passage as already preserved source detail, reader-owned Evergreen candidate, unsupported, or unresolved. It surfaces classifications for user approval and never silently deletes or reclassifies material.

test_cases.prompt: A legacy note selected for semantic Reference migration is actually a Person note.
test_cases.expected_output: Excludes it from Reference migration as a surfacing-only Mentioned referent and leaves it unchanged.

test_cases.prompt: Semantic Reference migration was interrupted after its synthesis checkpoint.
test_cases.expected_output: Resumes the same migration work_id from manifest.json, synthesis-map.json, and draft.md, recomputes fingerprints for every Literature, Resource, source-map, target, and links.jsonl input, and blocks publication on any changed input while preserving recoverable work.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for a concise bounded concept, a named framework, a tool, an event, and a creative work
test_cases.expected_output: Adapts the same bounded lookup shape across all five subject kinds: clean H1, concise definition, essential characteristics where useful, and Resource-only provenance without subtype-specific headings or a source dossier.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for an insufficient coined term with no independent support
test_cases.expected_output: Leaves the coined term unresolved at the source-independence gate, reports the independent support needed, leaves the wikilink untouched, and creates no provisional artifact or work_id.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note for materially disputed definitions with competing grounded variants
test_cases.expected_output: Preserves both variants in synthesis-map.json, surfaces the conflict, and waits for independent support or an explicit user resolution instead of silently selecting a definition.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note extending an existing note where the new grounded source adds warrant only
test_cases.expected_output: Uses extend-provenance, keeps the existing body bytes and aliases stable, appends only a deduplicated Resource, and finalizes the artifact and Resource→Reference ledger edge together with compare-and-swap fingerprints.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note extending an existing note where the new grounded source changes the definition boundary
test_cases.expected_output: Uses recompose, changes only the bounded body fields required by the new synthesis, preserves aliases and prior provenance, and finalizes the note and links mutation atomically.

test_cases.prompt: make-reference-note directly for a source that has not yet gone through make-literature-note
test_cases.expected_output: Stops at the Literature-first boundary and hands the source to make-literature-note; it does not synthesize a Reference from ungrounded material.
